title: Database authentication failure from omitted user variable
root_cause: The visible PostgreSQL authentication error is a symptom of a missing DB_USER in the test step. The client defaults to postgres while the service is initialized with the app_test user, so it authenticates as the wrong account.

relevant_evidence.why: The connection fails authentication as postgres.
The client defaults DB_USER to postgres when it is absent.
The service is initialized with app_test as its user.
The test step supplies database settings but omits DB_USER.
